Privacy policy

For the gymemo app. Updated November 11, 2026.

Data collection

None.

Ads, analytics, and tracking

None.

Storage

On each device. No cloud sync.

Watch

Paired Watch and iPhone exchange exercises, sets, and storage confirmations.

Backups and exports

System backups may include records, depending on device settings. You choose where to export or share files.

Retention and deletion

Records remain until deleted. Delete sets and unused exercises in the app.

Remove the app and its data from each device to erase all records. Delete exported files and device backups.

Support emails

Used to reply and investigate problems, then deleted after resolution. Request deletion at hi@yasunobu.dev.
